event.event_id.desc: A unique identifier for the event

event.event_name.desc: Name or title of the event

event.event_date.desc: The date the event took place or is scheduled to take place

event.type.desc: The kind of event, such as game, social, election

event.notes.desc: A free text field for any notes about the event

event.location.desc: Address where the event was held or is to be held or the name of such a location

event.status.desc: One of three values indicating if the event is in planning, is opened, or is closed

major.major_id.desc: A unique identifier for each major

major.department.desc: The name of the department that offers the major

major.college.desc: The name college that houses the department that offers the major

zip_code.zip_code.desc: The ZIP code itself. A five-digit number identifying a US post office.

zip_code.city.desc: The city to which the ZIP pertains

zip_code.county.desc: The county to which the ZIP pertains

zip_code.state.desc: The name of the state to which the ZIP pertains

zip_code.short_state.desc: The abbreviation of the state to which the ZIP pertains

attendance.link_to_event.desc: The unique identifier of the event which was attended

attendance.link_to_member.desc: The unique identifier of the member who attended the event

budget.budget_id.desc: A unique identifier for the budget entry

budget.category.desc: The area for which the amount is budgeted, such as, advertisement, food, parking

budget.spent.desc: The total amount spent in the budgeted category for an event.

budget.remaining.desc: A value calculated as the amount budgeted minus the amount spent

budget.amount.desc: The amount budgeted for the specified category and event

budget.link_to_event.desc: The unique identifier of the event to which the budget line applies.

expense.expense_description.desc: A textual description of what the money was spend for

expense.expense_date.desc: The date the expense was incurred

expense.cost.desc: The dollar amount of the expense

expense.approved.desc: A true or false value indicating if the expense was approved

expense.link_to_member.desc: The member who incurred the expense

expense.link_to_budget.desc: The unique identifier of the record in the Budget table that indicates the expected total expenditure for a given category and event.

income.income_id.desc: A unique identifier for each record of income

income.date_received.desc: the date that the fund received

income.source.desc: A value indicating where the funds come from such as dues, or the annual university allocation

income.notes.desc: A free-text value giving any needed details about the receipt of funds

member.position.desc: The position the member holds in the club

member.t_shirt_size.desc: The size of tee shirt that member wants when shirts are ordered

member.phone.desc: The best telephone at which to contact the member

member.zip.desc: the zip code of the member's hometown

member.link_to_major.desc: The unique identifier of the major of the member. References the Major table

budget.grain: one budget category for one event

relations.result: USD amounts; spent plus remaining equals amount
